verdict.rationale: An in-browser toolbar on deployed sites is a reasonable question for a cloud application platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a toolbar, on-site feedback, feature-flag management, or in-page performance inspection. Infrastructure metrics and ephemeral previews are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
